maddeler.e:
أرتعب (form VIII)
# أَرْتَعِبُ (ʔartaʕibu) /ʔar.ta.ʕi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
# أَرْتَعِبَ (ʔartaʕiba) /ʔar.ta.ʕi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
# أَرْتَعِبْ (ʔartaʕib) /ʔar.ta.ʕib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَعَبَ (irtaʕaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
